weights_note: sha256 values and sizes as `run.sh install --weights DIR` checks them (opt/rfdiffusion1_opt/weights.py: each file is fetched from its url_kit_installer when absent, then its size and sha256 are compared with these values; a mismatch is named, exit 1); WEIGHTS = the directory holding the files (inference.model_directory_path)

pinned_stack.tested_on: NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (sm90) and NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (sm80) with this stack as environment/Dockerfile lays it down (python 3.11.5, torch 2.4.0+cu121, dgl 2.4.0+cu124, triton 3.0.0); documentation only — nothing compares against this line
pinned_stack.install: environment/Dockerfile: environment/requirements.lock installed with `pip install --no-deps -r`, then stock and the kit (README.md 'Setup', routes A-C)

stack_check.note: stock/check_pins.py compares the installed distribution versions of these two with these values, local tags (+cu121 / +cu124) stripped on both sides: torch's pip metadata version reads 2.4.0 for the 2.4.0+cu121 wheel while torch.__version__ reads 2.4.0+cu121; the CUDA-graph levers refuse below dgl 2.0 on their own (opt/forward/fast_inference/drivers/rfd_fullgraph.py supported())

pinned_stack.torch_index: PyPI: torch 2.4.0's default Linux wheel is the CUDA 12.1 build (the pip metadata version reads 2.4.0, torch.__version__ reads 2.4.0+cu121); its CUDA / cuDNN / NCCL runtime libraries are the nvidia-*-cu12 lines of environment/requirements.lock

upstream_declared.note: neither declared environment is the pinned stack

stock_environment.note: must_be_absent_prefixes: an entry ending in '_' is a prefix, any other entry an exact name — the kit namespace only: the kits' switches (RFD_*), this package's own (RFDIFFUSION1_*) and the base driver's card override (ALLOW_ANY_GPU); torch's, CUDA's and the caller's own environment (NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE, TORCH_ALLOW_TF32_CUBLAS_OVERRIDE, CUDA_MPS_*, BLAS / ISA words, …) reaches the stock process as the caller set it and is the caller's to record; allowed_exceptions name the two data paths the stock CLI is given
